items.title: Rob Mounsey interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, April 9, 2025
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I’m wondering if there was — you made me think of George Martin, and did you take note? [INTERVIEWEE] My favorite Beatle.

ctx.x: You know at that time I was kind of a little classical music snob and I wasn’t really — I thought I was just above all that pop music stuff. I was a skinny little music nerd with glasses and I was learning to — you know I had learned to read music by studying orchestra scores and when The Beatles broke on Ed Sullivan I just thought oh that stuff is not for me. But privately, you know, I was hearing “Meet The Beatles” over the backyard fence and thinking I kind of really like the way those guitars sound. And you…
I’m wondering if there was — you made me think of George Martin, and did you take note?
